name: Lead Finder
intro: Lead Finder helps you find local businesses that may need video. Search a niche and a place, review the prospects, and keep the good ones as leads.

features.find-businesses: The Find businesses button opens the search window. Pick a niche, type a location, and run the search to build a prospect list in moments.
features.niches: The niche dropdown narrows your search to the right kind of business, from restaurants and salons to home contractors and pet services.
features.search-radius: Search Radius buttons let you widen or narrow the area, from five miles up to fifty, so you can cover just your town or the whole region.
features.find-my-brand-button: Find My Brand lets you paste a business website to pull in its logo, photos and branding for free, giving you real assets for a personalized demo.
features.saved-leads: The Saved leads list keeps every prospect you save, with a count and a Refresh button, so your whole pipeline stays in one place.
features.pipeline-stages: Every lead has a stage, from New to Converted. Update it as you go, so you always know who to follow up with next.

outro: That's Lead Finder. Search, save, and track your prospects, then turn each one into a personalized video pitch.
